description: GPU memory needed to SERVE a language model: weights (by quantization: fp32, fp16, q8, q4), KV cache (grows with context × batch: the part people forget) and an overhead you set; whether it fits a given GPU (or several), the longest context that fits, and the decode speed CEILING (tokens/s ≤ bandwidth / active weight bytes — mixture-of-experts read only their active experts). Known models and GPUs by id, or any model from the numbers in its config.json. Deterministic.

activeParameters.description: Parameters used per token (mixture of experts)

bandwidthGBs.description: Memory bandwidth in GB/s, for the speed ceiling

context.description: Tokens per sequence. Default: the model's maximum

gpuMemoryGiB.description: Or the GPU memory in GiB (as advertised in "GB")

model.description: A known model. Alternative to architecture

overhead.description: Extra fraction over weights + KV for activations and the runtime (an assumption)

name: llm_memory
title: Does this LLM fit in my GPU?
